crossRefs.note: Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!
Yahweh, who gives the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, who…
that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and…

translations.web: the sun to rule by day; for his loving kindness endures forever;
